fields.description:
## Outcome and context

Wagertech's notes describe a Fraud Flags related list on the Player record, then immediately raise an open question directly to Kobi and Taryn: whether to simplify this and just flag fraud directly in the Signup list instead of building a separate table. Taryn has confirmed this should stay open as its own ticket for her and Kobi to decide, rather than picking a direction now.

## Current state

BUILD-184 (PL-14, WAGR-195) scoped a dedicated Fraud Flags related list on the Player record (columns: Flag ID, Reason, Source Record, Raised By, Raised, Status), sourced from the prototype only and not yet confirmed in any transcript. BUILD-180 (WAGR-197) already built a Sign-Ups Related List on the Player record, which could be where a "Fraud Flagged" indicator gets added instead. The underlying Fraud Flag object and business rule (DECISION-02/03, WAGR-295 and WAGR-1) are also still open.

## Proposed solution

No solution decided yet. Two directions on the table:

1. Keep BUILD-184 (WAGR-195) as scoped — a separate Fraud Flags related list.
2. Simplify — add a fraud indicator/column to the existing Sign-Ups Related List (BUILD-180 / WAGR-197) and drop the separate related list.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Kobi and Taryn have decided between the two directions above (or another alternative).
2. Once decided, this ticket is updated or superseded by a build ticket reflecting the chosen direction.

## Dependencies

Depends on the Fraud Flag object and business rule being defined (DECISION-02/03 — WAGR-295, WAGR-1). Related to BUILD-184 — Player: Fraud Flags Related List (WAGR-195) and BUILD-180 — Player: Sign Ups Related List (WAGR-197).

## Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Wagertech Notes section), Player record doc, reviewed Sep 2026: "Fraud Flags related list... can we simplify this and just flag fraud directly in the Signup list rather than having a separate table." Taryn confirmed (Sep 2026) this should be tracked as an open decision rather than resolved now. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mp3b1qpJkzKNDztEQpdnv-BYCgUgDdXe5jLuJi-ix1U/edit?tab=t.0
fields.summary: Player: Decide Fraud Flag Presentation — Related List vs. Signup List Flag

comments.body:
**Decision:** Option 2 — flag fraud directly in the Sign-Ups related list on Player, rather than building a separate Fraud Flags related list.

**What this means:** Add `Fraud_Flag__c` and `Fraud_Review_Status__c` as columns on the existing Sign-Ups related list. Both fields already exist on Sign_Up__c (confirmed via sandbox schema check, Sep 16) — no new object, no rollup, no automation needed to support this.

**Reply for Emily's doc comment:**

> Yes — we can simplify this and flag fraud directly in the Sign-Up list. We'll add Fraud and Fraud Review Status as columns there: both fields already exist on Sign-Up, and having both lets you tell a confirmed flag from a dismissed one at a glance.
